name: Raging Fury
description:
You go into a rampage, spewing flames about for three rounds. For up to three rounds while concentrating, make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. Concentration ends at the end of the third round after activing this move, when you miss with this move, or fail to use this move; you cannot lose concentration on Raging Fury as a result of taking damage, and you cannot willingly drop concentration. While concentrating, you may only attack with Raging Fury.

When concentration ends, you become confused.
